source.detail: GLEIF LEI 558600E4C9MWY6TUVP22, entity status ACTIVE, legal address Dubai. ⚠ Sourced from GLEIF because the Central Bank of the UAE's own register is bot-protected and returns 403 to an honestly-identified client — a bank we cannot enumerate is a bank whose RFP we cannot watch for, so the identity graph was used as the substitute instrument. GLEIF carries NO industry classification: the segment here is inferred from the legal name and must be confirmed before this record is worked. ⚠ This is a BRANCH of a foreign bank. Unlike a representative office a branch does conduct business locally, so it is a real prospect — but the platform decision may sit with the parent.
